record.category: Game-mod repository — unlimited hosting, GB-scale files

free_tier.stated: Vendor help page states it outright: 'Unlimited storage and distribution for mods and images that you create. Unlimited file hosting for mods and images that you've created and uploaded.' Their own wiki table: Maximum Storage 'Unrestricted', Upload Limitations 'Unlimited (20GB limit through the browser, contact us for larger uploads)'.

egress.terms: Free, no egress quota. But per-IP shaped (see reliability_note). No Cloudflare in front of the file CDN; downloads come from their own edge.

record.interface_detail: Web upload + REST API v1 (api.nexusmods.com, `users/validate.json` returned 401 unauthenticated = live and auth-gated, not dead). Free API key issued per account.
record.tooling: REST + a maintained community uploader (Digitalroot.ModUploader, supports `nexusmods` commands).
record.chaining: Offers 20 GB per object with no aggregate storage quota. Downloads require session authentication or API keys, operating as an archive store rather than a direct origin.
record.limits_note: per-object-cap 20 GB via browser, larger by request. per-ip-shaping is the binding number: ~1 MB/s regular, ~1.5 MB/s with an adblocker, 3 MB/s Supporters; uncapped only for Premium (paid). Resumable downloads are free only on files >500 MB.
record.reliability_note: The 1–1.5 MB/s un-premium cap is the real constraint. ~3.5–5 GB/hour per stream, so per-IP-shaping governs, not storage. Files are virus-scanned and quarantined on false positives (WinRAR .rar especially).

evidence.proved: 'Unlimited storage and distribution' and 'Unlimited file hosting' as free Basic benefits
Nexus Mods row: Maximum Storage Unrestricted, Upload Limitations 20GB via browser
speed cap table: ~1.5MB/s adblock, 3MB/s Supporter, uncapped Premium
resumable downloads free only on files over 500MB, still in beta
401 (endpoint alive, auth required); www.nexusmods.com itself 403s plain curl (Cloudflare)
